Service and Remembrance September 11th is Patriot Day and a National Day of Service and Remembrance. Submitted by eschneider on Wed, 03/29/2023 - 13:58 Honor 9/11 Day Through a Lifetime of Service It’s been more than two decades since 9/11. Honor and commemorate the sacrifices made that day by remembering the heroes, armed forces, first responders, and countless others’ acts of service to defend our nation’s freedom. On the September 11 National Day of Service and Remembrance, Americans of all ages and backgrounds are again invited to join and lead community service projects to honor the lives and service of those we lost on September 11. Cross divides, differences, and ideologies to serve with neighbors and strangers alike to build important bridges in your communities. The 9/11 Day of Service is Wednesday, Sept. 11, 2024. You and your partners are encouraged to engage with your community and create lasting impact. A Day to Remember Remember the fallen by lifting our communities and honor the heroes by becoming one to someone in need. Make a difference, unite through service, and show we remember. Share this Video Commit to Serve on 9/11 Day Volunteer Use the AmeriCorps Volunteer Search, powered by VolunteerMatch, to find an opportunity near you. Find project ideas, toolkits, webinar dates, and more. Get started Register a Volunteer Opportunity Publicize your volunteer opportunities for the September 11 National Day of Service and Remembrance by adding them to AmeriCorps Volunteer Search. To be discoverable in search results for 9/11 Day, you must use #911 in the title of the project. Create a free project listing with one of these organizations: Idealist , JustServe , or VolunteerMatch That's it, anyone searching for 9/11 Day volunteer opportunities on our site will see your post. If you have questions about registering or promoting your volunteer opportunities, please contact Sept11@americorps.gov . 9/11 Day Grantees Learn about funding opportunities and apply now for a 9/11 Day grant with AmeriCorps. summary: The September 11 National Day of Service and Remembrance encourages Americans to honor 9/11 heroes and victims through community service projects. It is open to individuals of all ages and backgrounds, fostering unity across divides. The next observance is on Wednesday, September 11, 2024. Participants are urged to create meaningful community impact and can use the AmeriCorps Volunteer Search to find local opportunities.
